scorecard.rationale: A Parkinson whole-saffron powder trial reported global cognition without a separate executive estimate. A dried-extract childhood ADHD trial gave inconclusive executive-related comparisons. SaiLuoTong improved a switching measure by a one-tailed test in older adults with mild cognitive impairment, but its interval spans zero and it combines three ingredients. Dried saffron and executive function in Parkinson disease remain unresolved. The 1994 oral ethanolic extract improved selected passive-avoidance outcomes after an ethanol challenge, with no clear effect in normal or scopolamine-challenged mice. These short-term memory tasks do not measure a dried-saffron specific clinical executive-function result.
